name: CubeFacesCard
job: A service card shaped as a rotating cube whose four faces carry overview, process, price and proof
visitor_action: hover-drag or swipe to rotate; arrows and tab buttons jump to a face
owner_settings: Four faces (label, title, text, key figure and its note)
mobile: swipe rotates, face tabs shown below
motion: 3D quarter-turn with spring settle and slight idle drift (reduced-motion: tabbed faces with fade)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Ceramic block: glazed off-white tile faces with cobalt line icons, soft ambient occlusion, hairline bevel catching light
notes: Not yet rendered or seen by the builder (QA sweep pending). Known risk: face text colors are fixed navy, so a dark Face color setting would hurt contrast. 2026-11-23: targeted fix (Sonnet 5.5, QA fail): cube pushed left with horizon word bleeding right + tilted floor (narrow: word peeks over cube), stat splits number/unit and sizes to fit (never truncated), tabs wrap 2x2 at phone width; not yet re-rendered, QA to re-sweep. 2026-11-23: surgical fix 2 (worst-375): face grid column pinned to minmax(0,1fr) so worst content no longer overflows the face (tag/note were clipped), tag wraps instead of ellipsizing, note clamp ellipsis kept inside the face, tabs wrap to full labels (13px at phone width); not yet re-swept by QA.
